subject: Putting vertical spaces between categories in a legend

messages.author: 860d1b0d3a763a0e
messages.subject: Putting vertical spaces between categories in a legend
parts:
Greeting from Germany,

Could someone point to me out the ggplot2 function used to put spaces between the categories in the ggplot2 legend. For instance the spaces I have marked in blue on my map. I have used R base to generate the map but would really like to use ggplot2. I would really appreciate any idea.

Regards

Dikko

messages.author: e83d54ec65b5b8e6
messages.subject: Re: Putting vertical spaces between categories in a legend
parts:
Have a look at the ggplot2 function theme and at its parameters starting with legend.

Dear Erich,

Thanks for your response. I got the solution.  guides(fill = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE)).     will do the trick.

I really appreciate

Regards,
Dikko
